investigations.name: iirabm
investigations.title: Reproducing Cockrell & An (2018): controllability of sepsis in the IIRABM
investigations.description: This investigation reproduces the figures and results of Cockrell RC, An G, "Examining the controllability of sepsis using genetic algorithms on an agent-based model of systemic inflammation," PLoS Comput Biol 14(2):e1005876 (2018). The IIRABM is wrapped as a real-bridge process-bigraph Process (viva_iirabm.IIRABMProcess); every number is produced by the original C++ model. The compute-heavy portions of the paper (GA training and the 8,291-set generalizability sweep) used ~1,000,000 CPU-hours on Cray supercomputers and are reproduced here as METHOD at reduced scale, clearly labeled.
